gold: Primary invasive lobular breast carcinoma in heterotopic cutaneous breast tissue

selector.rationale: Hidradenocarcinoma is supported by the presence of apocrine glands and the 'Indian file pattern' of tumor cells, as well as positive immunohistochemistry for GATA3 and estrogen receptor

rejected.label: Extramammary Paget Disease
rejected.why: while it shares some histological features, the presence of apocrine glands and specific immunohistochemical markers points more strongly towards Hidradenocarcinoma
